description: Seeded Jira tickets linked to the demo PRs. Served by the seeded planning adapter, which has the same interface as the real Jira adapter.

tickets.summary: Refresh ad copy for the spring sale
tickets.description: Marketing wants the product-page ads to lead with 'Spring sale'. Update the ad text only; no changes to targeting or the AdService API.
acceptance: Ad text for binoculars, telescopes and imagers mentions the spring sale

tickets.summary: Show up to 10 stable recommendations on the product page
tickets.description: Product page carousel should show up to 10 recommendations instead of 5, and the list should be stable between reloads (no random shuffle). Make the max configurable via RECOMMENDATION_MAX_RESPONSES.
acceptance: ListRecommendations returns up to 10 product ids

tickets.summary: Add currency code to the charge response for refund reporting
tickets.description: Finance needs the settlement currency on every charge so refunds can be reconciled. Add a currency_code field to ChargeResponse and populate it in the payment service. This is additive; existing consumers must keep working.
acceptance: Additive change only; no existing fields change

tickets.description: Set a TTL on cart keys in Valkey so abandoned carts are cleaned up after 7 days.
acceptance: Cart keys carry a 7 day TTL

tickets.summary: Retry payment once on transient gRPC UNAVAILABLE
tickets.description: Checkout should retry the Charge call once when payment returns UNAVAILABLE, with an idempotency key.
Reduce load on quote by caching identical quote requests for 60s in the shipping service.
acceptance: Identical quote requests within 60s are served from cache

tickets.description: Currency conversion to JPY must round to whole units.
